 5                THE SECRETARY:   Legislative 

 6   Resolution Number 4687, by Senator Phillips, 

 7   commending Westbrook Preparatory School upon the 

 8   occasion of celebrating its 7th Anniversary on 

 9   February 5, 2018.

10                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Senator 

11   Phillips.

12                SENATOR PHILLIPS:   Thank you, 

13   Mr. President.

14                So about 12 years ago, New York 

15   started a plan to bring students with special 

16   needs back into New York State who had previously 

17   been sent out of the state to get an education.  

18   And after years of planning, about seven years 

19   ago, Westbrook Preparatory School was founded.  

20                Westbrook is in Westbury, New York, 

21   it's in my Senate district.  And I'm honored 

22   today to welcome several of the students from 

23   Westbrook Preparatory School.

24                It is the first residential New York 

25   State Regents junior and senior high school for 


                                                                2143

 1   students with Asperger's syndrome, 

 2   high-functioning autism, and related conditions.  

 3                So thank you to all of you for your 

 4   time, your dedication to these students.  And 

 5   thank you, students, for coming and blessing us 

 6   with your presence today.

 7                Thank you, Mr. President.

 8                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Thank 

 9   you, Senator Phillips.  The --

10                (Applause.)

15                We welcome the students and staff of

18   ask that you please rise and be recognized.
